t: This is Cosway Street, in the City of Westminster, named after Richard Cosway. He was a leading English portrait painter of the Georgian and Regency era, best known for his miniatures. He was friends with William Blake and the Chevalier d'Éon, fellow Freemasons and Swedenborgians. His wife, the Italian-born painter Maria Cosway, was a close friend of Thomas Jefferson. So the name here points to a painter, and to a couple whose circle reached well beyond London.
